name: n8n-deploy
description: Self-hosted n8n automation stack with deployment, media processing, and admin tooling
author: Atharva Devasthali

scripts.add-pkg: sh -c 'pip3.11 install "$0" && echo "$(pip3.11 freeze | grep ^$0==)" >> requirements.txt'
scripts.lint:api: cd api && ./venv/bin/python -m isort . && ./venv/bin/python -m black . && ./venv/bin/python -m ruff check .
scripts.ansible:deploy:multi: npm run ansible:gen-workers && ansible-playbook -i ansible/inventory/multi/main.yml ansible/playbooks/deploy_main.yml && ansible-playbook -i ansible/inventory/multi/workers_dynamic.yml ansible/playbooks/deploy_workers.yml
scripts.ansible:rollback:multi: npm run ansible:gen-workers && ansible-playbook -i ansible/inventory/multi/ ansible/playbooks/rollback.yml
scripts.docker:dev: npm run docker:down:dev && npm run docker:up:dev
scripts.docker:dev:n8n: npm run docker:down:dev && rm -rf loki-data/* && npm run docker:up:dev:n8n
scripts.docker:up:dev: sh sh_files/setup_n8n_files.sh && HOST_PROJECT_DIR=$(pwd) docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml up --build -d
scripts.docker:up:dev:n8n: sh sh_files/setup_n8n_files.sh && HOST_PROJECT_DIR=$(pwd) docker compose --env-file .env -f docker/docker-compose.dev.yml --profile n8n up --build -d
scripts.docker:prod: npm run docker:down:prod && rm -rf loki-data/* && npm run docker:up:prod
scripts.docker:prod:main: npm run docker:down:prod:main && rm -rf loki-data/* && npm run docker:up:prod:main
scripts.docker:prod:worker: npm run docker:down:prod:worker && npm run docker:up:prod:worker
scripts.docker-rm-cache: docker container prune -f && docker image prune -a -f && docker volume prune -f && docker builder prune -a -f
